preconditions.expression: len(h1) == 3 and all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**5 for x in h1)
preconditions.description: The first line contains three non-negative integers representing the Hamming distances between s1 and s2, s1 and s3, s1 and s4.

preconditions.expression: len(h2) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**5 for x in h2)
preconditions.description: The second line contains two non-negative integers representing the Hamming distances between s2 and s3, s2 and s4.
The third line contains a single non-negative integer representing the Hamming distance between s3 and s4.

preconditions.expression: any(x > 0 for x in h1 + h2 + [h3])
preconditions.description: At least one of the Hamming distances is positive.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == -1 or (len(return_value) == 5 and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in return_value[1:]) and all(len(x) == return_value[0] for x in return_value[1:]))
postconditions.description: If there is no suitable set of strings, print -1. Otherwise, print the length of the strings followed by the four strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == -1 or (h(return_value[1], return_value[2]) == h1[0] and h(return_value[1], return_value[3]) == h1[1] and h(return_value[1], return_value[4]) == h1[2] and h(return_value[2], return_value[3]) == h2[0] and h(return_value[2], return_value[4]) == h2[1] and h(return_value[3], return_value[4]) == h3)
postconditions.description: The pairwise Hamming distances between the restored strings must match the given distances.
